sections.heading: 7.2.1 Track Sizes
sections.observedText: Percentages are relative to the inner inline size of the grid container in column tracks and inner block size in row tracks. If grid-container size depends on its tracks, the percentage is treated as auto for intrinsic size calculation, then resolved against the resulting grid-container size for layout.
sections.observedText2: For minmax(min, max), if max is less than min, max is floored by min.

sections.heading: Grid Sizing Algorithm
sections.observedText: The track sizing algorithm resolves the columns and then resolves the rows; row sizing can use the column sizes calculated in the preceding step.
